name: Avatar
summary: Represent a person or entity with a photo, initials, or an icon — solo or in a stacked group.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-avatar> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. The DS V3 Avatar is a small matrix: THREE content modes (an image `src`, the initials of `name`, or an `<aha-icon>` glyph via `icon`), two `shape`s (circle · square), a named or numeric `size` (small 24 · default 40 · large 64), and a `color` ground tint. A sibling <aha-avatar-group> overlaps stacked children and collapses the overflow past `max` into a trailing +N chip. A purely static display marker, so it declares no motion. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitives are defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Size
spec.value: small 24 · default 40 · large 64 (named), or any numeric px via `size`

spec.label: Icon
spec.value: <aha-icon> glyph by name, ~half the avatar diameter, currentColor

props.name: name
props.desc: Full name; initials are derived when no src/icon. Also the alt/aria-label

props.name: src
props.desc: Image URL; the photo content mode (overrides icon/initials)

props.name: icon
props.desc: DS icon name (e.g. 'system-user'); the glyph content mode when no src

props.name: size
props.desc: 24 / 40 / 64 named steps, or any numeric px

props.name: color
props.desc: Ground tint — an --aha-* token suffix, e.g. 'bg-positive'

props.name: max
props.desc: (aha-avatar-group) collapse children past this count into a +N chip

whenToUse.when: identifying a person or entity — a presenter, a participant, an author
a generic symbol, not a specific identity
labelling with a category rather than an identity

opinion.note: Always provide `name` even when `src` is set — it becomes the alt text and the initials fallback if the image fails. Prefer initials or a photo over a generic icon for a real identity; reserve the icon mode for a placeholder/guest slot. In a group, keep sizes uniform and set `max` so the +N chip stays legible.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Avatar + Avatar-Group component sets (fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy): 'supports images, Icons, or letters' → three content modes; circle/square shapes; small/default/large sizes; a colour ground; and a stacked group with a +N overflow. Initials/icon ground uses bg-accent (#F9F5FF) with purple-60 (#6A1EBB) — the brand-tint pairing across the system; `color` overrides the ground with any --aha-* token. Circle is the pill radius; square is the default 8 radius. Group children wear a 2px bg-container ring and overlap; the +N chip inherits the group size/shape.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe is the default 40px initials circle; the measure also asserts the square shape (radius 8) and the large (64) size on sibling avatars, plus that the group renders a +N overflow chip.
conformance.measure: (function(){var q=function(sel){var el=document.querySelector(sel);var a=el&&el.shadowRoot&&el.shadowRoot.querySelector('.avatar');return a?getComputedStyle(a):null;};var s=q('aha-avatar[data-probe]');var sq=q('aha-avatar[shape="square"]');var lg=q('aha-avatar[size="large"]');var grp=document.querySelector('aha-avatar-group');var chip=grp&&grp.shadowRoot&&grp.shadowRoot.querySelector('.overflow');return{w:s?s.width:null,radius:s?s.borderTopLeftRadius:null,bg:s?s.backgroundColor:null,color:s?s.color:null,squareRadius:sq?sq.borderTopLeftRadius:null,largeW:lg?lg.width:null,hasOverflow:!!chip};})()
